scope: Theorem 1.1 (Finite-graph comparison) of the manuscript “Buffered comparison and stopping-band resolution in critical Ising” (preprints/Buffered-comparison-and-stopping-band-resolution-in-critical-Ising-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d5167e3fe5fb85f4), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every two configurations b, b′ on J and every configuration a on I, e−4 arctanh q0 ≤ µ(σI = a | σJ = b, σF ) µ(σI = a | σJ = b′, σF ) ≤ e4 arctanh q0 . Either conditional law may be replaced by an arbitrary mixture of these laws. The bound is symmetric in the two terminal sets.
